claim.title: Bayes Gap Upper Bound Rate
claim.statement: The expected Bayes Gap E[RBG(M_hat_theta)] is upper bounded by a term proportional to m^(-2alpha/d_eff) + m/(pN) + 1/N (ignoring logarithmic factors), where m is the feature dimension, d_eff is the effective dimension, and alpha is the Holder exponent.
claim.test_plan: Using the synthetic setup from C2, vary the feature dimension m of the uniform-attention Transformer while keeping p and N fixed. Verify that the Bayes Gap decreases as m increases, consistent with the approximation error term m^(-2alpha/d_eff). Additionally, verify that for fixed m, the gap decreases as pN increases, consistent with the generalization term.
claim.success_criterion: The Bayes Gap decreases as m increases (for fixed p, N) and decreases as pN increases (for fixed m), with the trend direction matching the theoretical bound.
